titleEn: Minimum Cost to Make Array Equalindromic
title: 使数组成为等数数组的最小代价
summary: 把数组所有元素改成同一个正回文整数 y，且 y 严格小于十亿；修改代价为各元素与 y 的绝对差之和，求最小总代价。
insight: 绝对差之和关于目标值是凸函数，未限制时由中位数最小化；加入回文约束后，只需检查中位数两侧最近的回文数。把中位数的前半部分减一、保持或加一后镜像，并补充跨位数的全九与一零零一边界，就覆盖了最近的合法候选。
pitfalls: 目标必须是正数且严格小于 1000000000，零和十亿都不合法
偶数长度数组可取中间区间内任意值，实现使用右中位数
前半部分加减一可能改变位数，必须额外加入 99…99 与 100…001 边界
候选回文要在完整构造后过滤合法范围
绝对差总和可达约十的十四次方，必须使用 64 位整数

solutions.title: 中位数与相邻回文候选
solutions.idea: 利用凸性把无限目标范围缩减为常数个十进制镜像候选。
steps: 排序并取 nums[n/2] 作为中位数
取中位数字符串的前 ceil(length/2) 位
加入 10^(length-1)-1、10^length+1、1 与 999999999 处理位数边界
计算每个候选的绝对差总和并取最小值

code.java: class Solution { private long mirror(long half,boolean odd){long result=half,rest=odd?half/10:half;while(rest>0){result=result*10+rest%10;rest/=10;}return result;}private long cost(int[] nums,long target){long total=0;for(int value:nums)total+=Math.abs((long)value-target);return total;}public long minimumCost(int[] nums){Arrays.sort(nums);long median=nums[nums.length/2];String text=Long.toString(median);int length=text.length(),halfLength=(length+1)/2;long prefix=Long.parseLong(text.substring(0,halfLength));Set<Long> candidates=new HashSet<>();candidates.add(1L);candidates.add(999_999_999L);long power=1;for(int i=0;i<length;i++)power*=10;candidates.add(power/10-1);candidates.add(power+1);for(int delta=-1;delta<=1;delta++){long half=prefix+delta;if(half>0)candidates.add(mirror(half,(length&1)==1));}long answer=Long.MAX_VALUE;for(long candidate:candidates)if(candidate>=1&&candidate<1_000_000_000L)answer=Math.min(answer,cost(nums,candidate));return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { private fun mirror(halfValue:Long,odd:Boolean):Long{var result=halfValue;var rest=if(odd)halfValue/10 else halfValue;while(rest>0){result=result*10+rest%10;rest/=10};return result};private fun cost(nums:IntArray,target:Long):Long{var total=0L;for(value in nums)total+=kotlin.math.abs(value.toLong()-target);return total};fun minimumCost(nums:IntArray):Long{nums.sort();val median=nums[nums.size/2].toLong();val text=median.toString();val length=text.length;val halfLength=(length+1)/2;val prefix=text.substring(0,halfLength).toLong();val candidates=hashSetOf(1L,999_999_999L);var power=1L;repeat(length){power*=10};candidates.add(power/10-1);candidates.add(power+1);for(delta in -1..1){val half=prefix+delta.toLong();if(half>0)candidates.add(mirror(half,length%2==1))};var answer=Long.MAX_VALUE;for(candidate in candidates)if(candidate>=1L&&candidate<1_000_000_000L)answer=minOf(answer,cost(nums,candidate));return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { long long mirror(long long half,bool odd){long long result=half,rest=odd?half/10:half;while(rest){result=result*10+rest%10;rest/=10;}return result;}long long cost(vector<int>& nums,long long target){long long total=0;for(int value:nums)total+=llabs((long long)value-target);return total;}public:long long minimumCost(vector<int>& nums){sort(nums.begin(),nums.end());long long median=nums[nums.size()/2];string text=to_string(median);int length=text.size(),halfLength=(length+1)/2;long long prefix=stoll(text.substr(0,halfLength));vector<long long> candidates={1,999999999};long long power=1;for(int i=0;i<length;++i)power*=10;candidates.push_back(power/10-1);candidates.push_back(power+1);for(long long delta=-1;delta<=1;++delta)if(prefix+delta>0)candidates.push_back(mirror(prefix+delta,length%2));long long answer=LLONG_MAX;for(long long candidate:candidates)if(candidate>=1&&candidate<1000000000LL)answer=min(answer,cost(nums,candidate));return answer;} };
